data.name: Hint.Literal
data.value: Type a literal value, or {0} to reference a workflow variable.

data.name: Hint.Integer
data.value: Type a literal number, or use the parameter as {0} in raw BPMN to reference a workflow variable.

data.name: Hint.Expression
data.value: Prefix with {0} for an expression evaluated against workflow variables.

data.name: Hint.List
data.value: List parameter — reference a workflow variable (e.g. {0}). Literal authoring inside BPMN is a v2 follow-up.

data.name: Hint.Map
data.value: Map parameter — reference a workflow variable (e.g. {0}). Literal authoring inside BPMN is a v2 follow-up.
